description: Election Commission - M. S. M. Rilwan was Selected as the member of the Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's absence from meetings. It involves electoral procedures under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill the vacant seat. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government elections, making it a clear fit for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
